#### Supervision pays off, but every review costs tokens

Letting the VLA run alone is insufficient; GPT-6-Astra reviewing its proposed actions works, but costs tokens. Reviewing four at a time saves 63.5% of tokens over per-action review, and adding ICL gives the best result — at about 6.9× the tokens of the best closed-loop setting without ICL.
